description: A pragmatic and calculated individual with a strong sense of self-reliance, Westhung's existence is governed by a rational approach to life. They possess the ability to think critically and make informed decisions, often prioritizing their own needs above others'. Their independence and strategic thinking enable them to navigate complex situations with ease, but may also render them somewhat detached and unyielding in personal relationships. A clear-headed and level-headed person, Westhung is unlikely to be swayed by emotions or impulsive desires, including those related to romance and family.
